system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner in a plain high-necked nightdress and wrapper, standing at her bedroom doorway, glancing back toward Julia","action":"Julia pauses at the threshold of Helen's room, turning her head as if to ask a question, while Helen, seated near the lamp, listens with a faint smile","setting":"Helen's bedroom at Stoke Moran, with a tall window opening onto the dark lawn, a bed and a small table with an oil lamp","secondaryElements":"Faint drifting haze of strong cigar smoke in the corridor beyond; a door ajar; shadows of the lawn beyond the window; a distant hint of the plantation trees","mood":"Quiet, intimate, faintly uneasy, with restrained suspense beneath the chatter","timeOfDay":"Eleven o'clock at night, dim lamplight inside, dark and still outside","composition":"Medium interior shot framed by the doorway, Julia at left half in shadow, Helen seated at right in warm lamplight, window dark behind them"}
